$comment: Shape: globalFacts (object) + map: { canonicalId -> PlatformMapping }. PlatformMapping fields defined in ../schemas/breakdown.schema.json.

globalFacts.dependency: androidx.compose.material3:material3:1.5.0-alpha22  (stable line: 1.4.0). Wear OS uses androidx.wear.compose:compose-material3 — different lib.
globalFacts.theme: MaterialExpressiveTheme(colorScheme: ColorScheme?, motionScheme: MotionScheme?, shapes: Shapes?, typography: Typography?, content:) — alpha-only. Defaults: expressiveLightColorScheme(), MotionScheme.expressive(), expanded Shapes, default Typography. Access motion via MaterialTheme.motionScheme.
globalFacts.optIns: @ExperimentalMaterial3ExpressiveApi (LoadingIndicator, SplitButton, Carousel, WideNavigationRail, FloatingToolbar, MaterialShapes, Morph.toPath, 8-slot Shapes ctor, expressive menus); @ExperimentalMaterial3Api (most M3 components); @ExperimentalMaterial3ComponentOverrideApi (XR overrides).
globalFacts.shapes: 8-slot expressive scale: extraSmall, small, medium, large, largeIncreased, extraLarge, extraLargeIncreased, extraExtraLarge. Pass all 8 named.
globalFacts.motion: MotionScheme.standard() | MotionScheme.expressive(). Accessors: defaultEffectsSpec<T>(), defaultSpatialSpec<T>(), fastEffectsSpec<T>(). Consume via MaterialTheme.motionScheme. Separates spatial (bounds/position) from effects (color/alpha).
globalFacts.colorRoles: expressiveLightColorScheme() / expressiveDarkColorScheme(). Surface containers (central): surfaceContainer, surfaceContainerLow/Lowest/High/Highest, surfaceBright, surfaceDim. Fixed roles required since 1.4.0-alpha15.
globalFacts.noGlass: Android has NO Liquid Glass. Native Compose translucency: Surface(color=surfaceContainer.copy(alpha)) + Modifier.blur(radius) (API 31+) or RenderEffect.createBlurEffect — rendered via AndroidView(ComposeView). Apply motion.glass-blur accordingly.
globalFacts.shapeMorph: Morph.toPath(progress: Float, path: Path, startAngle: Int) from androidx.graphics:graphics-shapes. MaterialShapes factories (Squircle, Circle, Clover, Cookie, Slash...).
globalFacts.sharedElementMorph: Lives in androidx.compose.animation:animation (NOT material3): SharedTransitionLayout { SharedTransitionScope -> Modifier.sharedElement(...) / Modifier.sharedBounds(...) }. Pair with Morph.toPath for shape morphing.
globalFacts.alphaChurn: Alpha is volatile: MaterialShapes/LoadingIndicator promoted then REVERTED to experimental in alpha19. Pin exact version; never use +.
globalFacts.flutterBridge: NATIVE via platform view (operator mandate: no approximation). Flutter has NO Material 3 Expressive (umbrella #168813) — so embed NATIVE Compose expressive via AndroidView(ComposeView → MaterialExpressiveTheme, material3 1.5.0-alpha22), mirroring iOS UiKitView→SwiftUI. Interop: ComposeView/AbstractComposeView + setContent{} + ViewCompositionStrategy (dispose). CAVEATS: Android-only; every android primitive is a platform view (FPS/gesture/lifecycle cost — fidelity-first tradeoff); Hybrid Composition best on Flutter 3.44+/API 34+/Vulkan; dual-theme-system drift between Flutter MaterialTheme and Compose MaterialTheme. EMIT RULE: symbol = AndroidView(ComposeView) → Compose: <composable from flutter-widgets.json android map>; bridge = platformView (DEFAULT); nativeRef = map[id].symbol (the Compose expressive target); availability = material3 1.5.0-alpha22. pureFlutter approximation is an explicit operator opt-OUT only (edit catalog), NOT the default.
globalFacts.nativeDecoration: GATE G3 (native-decoration policy): a native Compose control carries ONLY native-vocabulary decoration — a Material icon (androidx Icons / material-icons via Compose Icon). The button contract has NO brand-glyph slot. A custom brand SVG the design paints inside a button (Google's 4-colour G, a partner logo) is NOT native vocabulary: in native mode DROP it from the render — do NOT rasterise/force it in. DROP != discard: the asset manager RECORDS every dropped glyph in the target's NON-bundled provenance/asset_ledger.json (origin, dims, vector, reason); design render mode reproduces it. Applied to EVERY button the SAME way, incl. social-auth — in native mode every social button (Apple, Google) is a native control and ALL brand marks drop; do NOT substitute an official provider button as the native default, and do NOT keep one provider's mark but not another's. The ONLY native way a dropped mark rides a native button is converting it to a native symbol (SF Symbol on iOS / Material icon on Android), which is currently closed for trademark brand marks (licence + exact-asset requirements).

surface.card.notes: No glass. For translucent: Surface(color = surfaceContainerHighest.copy(alpha=0.7f), shape=shapes.medium).

surface.glass.notes: No Liquid Glass on Android. Native Compose expressive Surface translucency via AndroidView (NOT Flutter BackdropFilter). Lean on surfaceContainer color roles + expressive elevation.

surface.sheet.notes: FlexibleBottomSheet = arbitrary detents. ModalBottomSheet = standard detents. sheetGestureEnabled param; isAnimationRunning on SheetState.

surface.popover.notes: Anchored popup. Expressive menus add groups/checkable items (alpha09).

surface.tooltip.api: TooltipBox(tooltip = { PlainTooltip { Text("Info") } }, state = tooltipState) { content }
surface.tooltip.notes: Plain/Rich tooltips. maxWidth plain 200dp, rich 320dp; caret support.

surface.toolbar.api: Scaffold(topBar = { LargeTopAppBar(title = { Text("Home") }, actions = { IconButton(onClick={}){ Icon(Icons.Default.Add, null) } }) }) { content }
surface.toolbar.notes: Use inside Scaffold. scrollBehavior for collapse. CenterAlignedTopAppBar for centered title.

surface.tabbar.api: NavigationBar { items.forEach { NavigationBarItem(selected = it == sel, onClick = {}, icon = { Icon(...) }, label = { Text(it.label) }) } }
surface.tabbar.notes: Primary bottom nav. Expressive variant via ComponentOverride (alpha16).

surface.navrail.notes: Large-screen rail. ModalWideNavigationRail for modal. LocalModalWideNavigationRailOverride (alpha22). Falls back to NavigationBar on compact.

surface.sidebar.notes: Permanent for tablet/desktop; Modal for phone; Dismissible for swipe.

surface.list.api: LazyColumn { items(list) { ListItem(headlineContent = { Text(it.title) }, leadingContent = { Icon(...) }) } }
surface.list.notes: ListItem has leading/trailing/overline slots. selectedLeadingIcon padding fixes alpha16.

action.button.api: Button(onClick = {}, shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.full) { Text("Save") }  // variants: filled=Button, secondary=FilledTonalButton, outline=OutlinedButton, ghost/link=TextButton, destructive=Button(containerColor=errorContainer)
action.button.notes: Expressive leans capsule shapes. Group connected buttons via ButtonGroup (expressive).

action.fab.availability: FAB stable; AnimatedFAB + FAB Menu expressive alpha19
action.fab.notes: Expressive adds AnimatedFloatingActionButton and FAB Menu.

action.segmented.api: SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow { options.forEachIndexed { i, label -> SegmentedButton(selected = i==sel, onClick = {}, shape = SegmentedButtonDefaults.itemShape(i, options.size)) { Text(label) } } }
action.segmented.notes: Expressive segmented control. shape per item via itemShape(index,count).

action.checkbox.api: Checkbox(checked = c, onCheckedChange = {})  // TriStateCheckbox for indeterminate

action.radio.notes: No native RadioGroup composable; group manually. Or use Select/SegmentedButton.

action.chip.api: FilterChip(selected = sel, onClick = {}, label = { Text(label) }, leadingIcon = { Icon(...) })  // assist/input/suggestion variants

input.text-field.api: OutlinedTextField(value = v, onValueChange = {}, label = { Text("Email") }, isError = false, supportingText = { Text(helper) })
input.text-field.notes: Outlined is default expressive. supportingText = helper/error. leading/trailing icon slots.

input.textarea.notes: Set heightIn; no dedicated textarea widget.

input.search.api: SearchBar(query = q, onQueryChange = {}, onSearch = {}, active = active, onActiveChange = {}) { content }
input.search.notes: Material SearchBar w/ expanded state. Expressive adds ExpandedDockedSearchBarWithGap.

input.select.api: ExposedDropdownMenuBox(expanded = exp, onExpandedChange = {}) { OutlinedTextField(..., trailingIcon = { ExposedDropdownMenuBox.TrailingIcon(exp) }); DropdownMenu(...) { options.forEach { DropdownMenuItem(...) } } }
input.select.notes: No dedicated Select composable. ExposedDropdownMenuBox pattern. AutoComplete = same pattern.

input.multiselect.api: FlowRow { options.map { FilterChip(selected = it in sel, onClick = {}, label = { Text(it) }) } }
input.multiselect.notes: No native multiselect. Chips or checkbox list.

input.stepper.notes: No native stepper. Build from IconButtons. Or SegmentedButton style.

input.date-picker.notes: DatePickerDialog wraps DatePicker. datePickerState for selection.

input.toggle-group.api: MultiChoiceSegmentedButtonRow { items.forEachIndexed { i, it -> SegmentedButton(checked = it in sel, onCheckedChange = {}, shape = SegmentedButtonDefaults.itemShape(i, items.size)) { Text(it) } } }

feedback.spinner.availability: LoadingIndicator expressive alpha (reverted exp alpha19); CircularProgressIndicator stable
feedback.spinner.notes: LoadingIndicator is the expressive flagship. ContainedLoadingIndicator = surface-wrapped. Wavy variants optional.

feedback.toast.notes: Snackbar through Scaffold. actionLabel for action.

feedback.alert.notes: M3 Compose has no Banner composable. Inline alert → custom Surface(surfaceVariant) + Text, or Snackbar/AlertDialog.

feedback.skeleton.symbol: Custom shimmer Box — no native skeleton
feedback.skeleton.notes: No native skeleton. Custom Box + animated gradient brush.

feedback.badge.api: BadgedBox(badge = { Badge { Text("3") } }) { Icon(...) }  // dot: Badge() empty
feedback.badge.notes: BadgedBox wraps content; Badge for count or dot.

display.text.notes: Map display→displaySmall, title→headlineMedium, subtitle→titleMedium, body→bodyLarge, caption→bodySmall, label→labelLarge, overline→labelSmall.uppercase. New Typography ctor accepts defaultFontFamily + emphasized scale (alpha16). TextAutoSize experimental.

display.icon.api: Icon(Icons.Filled.Home, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp), tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary)

display.avatar.api: AsyncImage(model = url, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp).clip(CircleShape))
display.avatar.notes: Use coil-compose AsyncImage. Initials fallback → Box+Text. Ring → border().

display.media.api: AsyncImage(model = url, contentDescription = null, contentScale = ContentScale.Crop, modifier = Modifier.aspectRatio(16f/9f).clip(shapes.medium))
display.media.notes: Coil AsyncImage + aspectRatio + clip. No background-extension equivalent.

display.stat.api: Column { Text("1,204", style = typography.displaySmall); Text("steps", style = typography.labelMedium, color = onSurfaceVariant) }

display.empty-state.api: Column(horizontalAlignment = CenterHorizontally) { Icon(Icons.Outlined.Inbox, null, Modifier.size(64.dp)); Text("Nothing here"); TextButton(onClick={}){Text("Add")} }
display.empty-state.notes: No native EmptyState composable in material3. Build custom.

navigation.tabs.api: TabRow(selectedTabIndex = sel) { tabs.forEachIndexed { i, t -> Tab(selected = i==sel, onClick = {}, text = { Text(t) }) } }

navigation.pagination.symbol: Custom Row of buttons — no native

navigation.dropdown-menu.api: DropdownMenu(expanded = exp, onDismissRequest = {}) { DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("Edit") }, onClick = {}); DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("Delete") }, onClick = {}, leadingIcon = { Icon(Delete,null) }) }
navigation.dropdown-menu.notes: Expressive menus add toggleable/selectable items, menu groups, popup. MenuDefaults updated alpha09.

navigation.context-menu.symbol: DropdownMenu on long-press (combinedClickable) — no native context menu
navigation.context-menu.api: Box(Modifier.combinedClickable(onClick = {}, onLongClick = { expanded = true })) { content }; DropdownMenu(expanded,...){}
navigation.context-menu.notes: No dedicated ContextMenu; use DropdownMenu triggered by combinedClickable onLongClick.

navigation.command.symbol: Custom SearchBar + List — no native command palette
navigation.command.api: Custom: SearchBar expanded + filtered LazyColumn of actions
navigation.command.notes: No native command palette. Native Compose SearchBar + filtered LazyColumn.

data.table.symbol: LazyColumn rows or Grid (no native table)
data.table.notes: material3 ships NO table/grid composable. Build from LazyColumn + Row, or RowScope columns. For interactive: third-party (two_dimensional_scrollables not in material3).

data.data-table.notes: No native data-table. Build with LazyColumn + stickyHeader + sorting state. Consider third-party.

data.carousel.api: HorizontalCarousel(state = carouselState) { items(count) { HeroCarouselItem(...) } }  // HeroCarousel center-focal
data.carousel.availability: Carousel/HeroCarousel expressive alpha16; HorizontalPager stable foundation
data.carousel.notes: Expressive Carousel family (Hero/Horizontal/Vertical/Stratified[unconfirmed]). CarouselState.currentItem observable. HorizontalPager = foundation fallback.

data.accordion.api: var exp by remember{mutableStateOf(false)}; ElevatedCard(onClick={exp=!exp}) { Column { Row{ Text(title); Icon(if(exp)ExpandMore else ExpandLess,null) }; AnimatedVisibility(exp){ content } } }
data.accordion.notes: No native Accordion in material3. Build expandable Card + AnimatedVisibility.

data.row.api: ListItem(headlineContent = { Text(h) }, supportingContent = { Text(sub) }, leadingContent = { Icon(..) }, trailingContent = { Text(meta) }, overlineContent = { Text(over) })
data.row.notes: material3 ListItem: headline + supporting(two-line) + leading + trailing + overline. Native via AndroidView(ComposeView). Numbered/plain via leadingContent.

data.chart.symbol: Vico compose-m3 / Canvas (NO first-party Material chart)
data.chart.api: // Vico: CartesianChartHost(chart = CartesianChart(..))  // or hand-rolled Canvas
data.chart.notes: Material/Compose has NO first-party chart (Google I/O 2025: none announced). Vico (compose-m3) is the leading Compose-native lib — perf caveats on large data; MPAndroidChart (view, via AndroidView) is the legacy alt. UNCONFIRMED: third-party, verify API. Embed via AndroidView(ComposeView) -> Vico.

motion.glass-blur.symbol: Modifier.blur(radius) (API 31+) over translucent Surface; RenderEffect fallback
motion.glass-blur.api: Surface(color = surfaceContainer.copy(alpha = 0.6f), shape = shapes.large, modifier = Modifier.blur(24.dp))
motion.glass-blur.availability: Modifier.blur API 31+; below → RenderEffect or skip
motion.glass-blur.notes: No Liquid Glass on Android. Native Compose expressive Surface translucency + Modifier.blur via AndroidView.

motion.spring-press.symbol: animateFloatAsState(spring) + graphicsLayer scale; or MotionScheme spec
motion.spring-press.api: val scale by animateFloatAsState(if (pressed) 0.95f else 1f, animationSpec = MaterialTheme.motionScheme.defaultSpatialSpec(), label="press"); Modifier.graphicsLayer { scaleX = scale; scaleY = scale }
motion.spring-press.notes: Press via pointerInput detectTapGestures/onPress. Use MotionScheme.expressive() specs for consistent motion.

motion.morph.availability: androidx.compose.animation stable; graphics-shapes Morph expressive alpha
motion.morph.notes: sharedElement/sharedBounds in androidx.compose.animation:animation. Pair with Morph.toPath for organic shape morph (Squircle etc.).

motion.rise-in.api: AnimatedVisibility(visible, enter = slideInVertically(animationSpec = MaterialTheme.motionScheme.defaultSpatialSpec()) { it/4 } + fadeIn()) { content }
motion.rise-in.notes: Entrance via AnimatedVisibility + MotionScheme spring spec.

motion.parallax.api: val s = rememberLazyListState(); Modifier.graphicsLayer { translationY = s.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset * 0.5f }
motion.parallax.notes: Custom scroll-coupled transform via LazyListState + graphicsLayer.
